title: Viceroy Lord Linlithgow's August Offer to seek support in war efforts which was rejected by the nationalist.
text: The August Offer was an offer made by Viceroy Linlithgow in 1940 promising the expansion of the Viceroy's Executive Council to include more Indians, the establishment of an advisory war council, the giving of full weight to minority opinion, and the recognition of the Indians' right to frame their own constitution after the end of the war.
